About this map

A detailed, self-contained interactive map of Singapore: official planning boundaries, the full MRT/LRT network with an offline journey planner, statistics choropleths, open-data layers, historical maps, walking tours and live rain radar.

Features

  • Journey planner — offline shortest-path over the rail graph (time + transfer penalty), with approximate distance-based fare.
  • Statistics map — population density (Census 2020) and median HDB resale price by planning area.
  • Open-data layers — NParks parks & park connectors, NEA hawker centres, NLB libraries, OSM hospitals & schools.
  • Historical maps — georeferenced NUS Libraries maps (1914–2010).
  • Walking tours — five curated heritage routes.
  • Live rain radar — RainViewer. Favourites, dark mode, PNG export and deep links.

LTA live data (optional)

Carpark availability and traffic incidents need a free LTA DataMall API key. Paste it below to try. Note: LTA's API does not send CORS headers, so browsers usually block direct calls from a local file — a small proxy/server is needed for these to work.

Data sources

  • Boundaries: URA Master Plan (data.gov.sg). Stations: OneMap/LTA + CCL6 + Punggol Coast.
  • Parks/PCN: NParks. Hawker centres: NEA. Libraries: NLB. Hospitals/schools: OpenStreetMap via HDX.
  • Population: SingStat Census 2020. HDB resale: HDB/data.gov.sg. Historical maps: NUS Libraries/SLA.
  • Basemaps © OpenStreetMap contributors, Esri, OpenTopoMap, MeMoMaps, CyclOSM. Rain radar: RainViewer.

Boundaries indicative, for reference only. Fares/times are estimates. Basemap tiles, radar and historical maps need internet; everything else is embedded. Built Nov 2026.
